description: Linhas de Transmissão do ONS - ANEEL 2020 (Minas Gerais) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Linhas de transmissão de energia do Sistema Interligado Nacional em operação. O dado representa as linhas de transmissão de energia em operação no Estado de Minas Gerais. Dados obtidos no Sistema de Informações Geográficas do Setor Energético Brasileiro da Empresa de Pesquisa Energética (EPE). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Linhas de transmissão, Energia elétrica, Distribuição de energia, Operador do Sistema Nacional, ONS. The portal shows 2023-04-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
